notes.title: Updating 1.0.2
notes.content:
In this update we implemented:

Option to jump kinematics
Improved Load Speed ​​at Dying
Inversion of View Axis in Options
Improvement in AI
Improvement in textures and lighting
Correction of texts

We will continue to work for new game modes!
Thanks for playing "The Falling Nights" and for your comments, because they always help us to improve.
